dual_certificate_discovery.convention: z = first m inequality marginals minus second m; lambda is the equality marginal for sum(weights)=1

scope: Finite binary64 minimax LP over the expanded 93-column physical pool (83 certified-pool columns plus ten 128-bit Arb-priced legal columns), all 1461 low rows, 256 screened sixth rows, seventeen Arb-certified sixth separators from five parent candidates, and seven selected eighth rows. The ten added columns violate the old 83-column dual inequalities; this LP is still finite binary64 discovery. No exact feasibility, complete sixth/eighth maximum, or physical global optimum is implied.
